entries.title: Psalms 83:1
segments: ¶<<A Song; a Psalm of Asaph.>> O God, keep not silence; hold not thy peace, and be not still, O *God:

entries.title: Psalms 83:2
segments: For behold, thine enemies make a tumult; and they that hate thee lift up the head.

entries.title: Psalms 83:3
segments: They take crafty counsel against thy people, and consult against thy hidden ones:

entries.title: Psalms 83:4
segments: They say, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation, and let the name of Israel be mentioned no more.

entries.title: Psalms 83:5
segments: For they have consulted together with one heart: they have made an alliance together against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 83:6
segments: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagarites;

entries.title: Psalms 83:7
segments: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia, with the inhabitants of Tyre;

entries.title: Psalms 83:8
segments: Asshur also is joined with them: they are an arm to the sons of Lot. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 83:9
segments: ¶Do unto them as to Midian; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the torrent of Kishon:

entries.title: Psalms 83:10
segments: Who were destroyed at Endor; they became as dung for the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 83:11
segments: Make their nobles as Oreb and as Zeeb; and all their chiefs as Zebah and as Zalmunna.

entries.title: Psalms 83:12
segments: For they have said, Let us take to ourselves God's dwelling-places in possession.

entries.title: Psalms 83:13
segments: O my God, make them like a whirling thing, like stubble before the wind.

entries.title: Psalms 83:14
segments: As fire burneth a forest, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire,

entries.title: Psalms 83:15
segments: So pursue them with thy tempest, and terrify them with thy whirlwind.

entries.title: Psalms 83:16
segments: Fill their faces with shame, that they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 83:17
segments: Let them be put to shame and be dismayed for ever, and let them be confounded and perish:

entries.title: Psalms 83:18
segments: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, art the Most High over all the earth.
